source:
# Wright engineering workflow source
# Stable names identify engineering items, steps, connection points, and routes.
# Versions, history, integrity digests, canvas layout, and run state are managed by Wright.
# Optional groups are shown only when they improve a larger or explicitly grouped workflow.

workflow mounting_bracket
  name: "Mounting bracket development"
  purpose: "Turn bracket requirements into a reviewed manufacturable STEP package."
  discipline: "mechanical.design"
  reviewed_ai_suggestions: true
end

item reference_images
  name: "Reference images"
  type: image_files
  formats: ["jpg","png"]
  description: "Engineer-supplied sketches, photographs, and marked-up JPG or PNG images."
end

item design_intent
  name: "Design intent"
  type: text_or_document
  formats: ["text","docx","pdf"]
  description: "Typed text or text from a common document describing use, loads, interfaces, constraints, units, and known material requirements."
end

item company_context
  name: "Company standards and context"
  type: company_knowledge
  formats: ["company_library"]
  description: "Approved company standards, preferred practices, and relevant prior-design guidance."
end

item design_specification
  name: "Reviewed design specification"
  type: design_document
  formats: ["markdown"]
  description: "Editable, reviewable source of truth for CAD and downstream engineering work."
end

item geometry
  name: "Bracket CAD model"
  type: cad_model
  formats: ["cad_model"]
  description: "Parametric bracket CAD model before design approval."
end

item manufacturability_report
  name: "Manufacturing check report"
  type: engineering_report
  formats: ["html_report"]
  description: "Manufacturing issues, evidence, and recommended corrections."
end

item approved_geometry
  name: "Approved CAD model"
  type: approved_cad_model
  formats: ["cad_model"]
  description: "CAD model plus its design-review decision."
end

item step
  name: "Mounting bracket STEP AP242 file"
  type: step_file
  formats: ["step_ap242"]
  description: "Neutral bracket CAD file for downstream use."
end

item release_package
  name: "Design handoff package"
  type: archive
  formats: ["zip"]
  description: "Local ZIP containing the approved STEP file and manufacturing report."
end

input reference_images
  name: "Reference images"
  purpose: "Add sketches, photographs, or marked-up images that show the intended bracket and interfaces."
  step_type: work
  group: null
  provided_by: engineer
  inputs: []
  outputs: [{"description":"Sketches, photographs, or marked-up JPG and PNG images supplied by the engineer.","item":"reference_images","key":"reference_images_out","kind":"reference_images","name":"Reference images","quantity":"many","required":true}]
  instructions: "Add one or more JPG or PNG images and identify any dimensions or interfaces that must be preserved."
  settings: {"accepted_formats":"JPG, PNG"}
  tool: null
  reusable_step: null
end

input design_intent
  name: "Design intent"
  purpose: "Describe how the bracket will be used, its loads, interfaces, constraints, and success criteria in text or a common document."
  step_type: work
  group: null
  provided_by: engineer
  inputs: []
  outputs: [{"description":"Engineer-entered text or a common document describing use, loads, interfaces, constraints, units, and known material requirements.","item":"design_intent","key":"design_intent_out","kind":"design_intent","name":"Design intent","quantity":"one","required":true}]
  instructions: "Enter design intent as text or add a common document. Include use, loads, interfaces, constraints, units, and known material requirements."
  settings: {"input_mode":"text-or-document","units":"mm"}
  tool: null
  reusable_step: null
end

input company_context
  name: "Company standards and context"
  purpose: "Bring in approved standards, preferred materials and processes, and relevant past designs."
  step_type: work
  group: null
  provided_by: company_library
  inputs: []
  outputs: [{"description":"Approved standards, preferred practices, and relevant prior-design guidance.","item":"company_context","key":"company_context_out","kind":"company_context","name":"Company standards and context","quantity":"one","required":true}]
  instructions: "Retrieve the company standards and prior-design guidance relevant to brackets, material selection, tolerancing, and manufacturing."
  settings: {"source":"approved-company-library"}
  tool: {"action":"knowledge.retrieve-company-context","assignment":"company_context"}
  reusable_step: null
end

task create_design_specification
  name: "Create and review design specification"
  purpose: "Combine the three input sources into an editable, reviewable source of truth before CAD work begins."
  step_type: review
  group: null
  performed_by: ai_then_engineer
  inputs: [{"description":"The engineer's text or document describing what the bracket must do.","item":"design_intent","key":"design_intent_in","kind":"design_intent","name":"Design intent","quantity":"one","required":true},{"description":"Visual references used to clarify shape, interfaces, and constraints.","item":"reference_images","key":"reference_images_in","kind":"reference_images","name":"Reference images","quantity":"many","required":true},{"description":"Approved company rules and reusable design knowledge.","item":"company_context","key":"company_context_in","kind":"company_context","name":"Company standards and context","quantity":"one","required":true}]
  outputs: [{"description":"Editable source of truth that separates supplied facts, assumptions, decisions, and unresolved questions.","item":"design_specification","key":"design_specification_out","kind":"design_specification","name":"Reviewed design specification","quantity":"one","required":true}]
  prompt: "Draft a concise engineering design specification from the design intent, reference images, and company context. Separate supplied facts from assumptions, flag conflicts and missing information, and require engineer review before release to CAD."
  settings: {"review_status":"needs-review"}
  tool: {"action":"ai.create-design-specification","assignment":"create_design_specification"}
  reusable_step: null
end

task generate_geometry
  name: "Create bracket CAD model"
  purpose: "Create a parametric L-bracket from the reviewed design specification."
  step_type: work
  group: null
  performed_by: configured_tool
  inputs: [{"description":"The reviewed source of truth used to create the bracket CAD model.","item":"design_specification","key":"design_specification_in","kind":"design_specification","name":"Reviewed design specification","quantity":"one","required":true}]
  outputs: [{"description":"Parametric bracket CAD model.","item":"geometry","key":"geometry_out","kind":"cad_model","name":"Bracket CAD model","quantity":"one","required":true}]
  instructions: "Create the bracket with two mounting holes and one slotted interface."
  settings: {"inside_radius_mm":4,"thickness_mm":6}
  tool: {"action":"tool.create-mounting-bracket","assignment":"generate_geometry"}
  reusable_step: null
end

task check_manufacturability
  name: "Run manufacturing checks"
  purpose: "Check bend radius, edge distance, thickness, and tool access."
  step_type: work
  group: null
  performed_by: ai_assisted
  inputs: [{"description":"CAD model to check for manufacturing issues.","item":"geometry","key":"geometry_check_in","kind":"cad_model","name":"Bracket CAD model","quantity":"one","required":true},{"description":"Approved dimensions, material, process, tolerances, and acceptance criteria used by the manufacturing checks.","item":"design_specification","key":"design_specification_check_in","kind":"design_specification","name":"Reviewed design specification","quantity":"one","required":true}]
  outputs: [{"description":"Manufacturing issues, supporting evidence, and recommended corrections.","item":"manufacturability_report","key":"report_out","kind":"manufacturing_report","name":"Manufacturing check report","quantity":"one","required":true}]
  prompt: "Check bend radius, edge distance, thickness, and tool access. For each issue, cite the CAD feature and material property that triggered it."
  settings: {"minimum_edge_ratio":1.5,"process":"machined-and-bent"}
  tool: {"action":"check.bracket-manufacturability","assignment":"check_manufacturability"}
  reusable_step: null
end

task review_design
  name: "Review CAD model for approval"
  purpose: "Approve the CAD model and manufacturing report or return the design for revision."
  step_type: reusable_step
  group: null
  performed_by: engineer
  inputs: [{"description":"Accepted design criteria used to judge the CAD model and manufacturing report.","item":"design_specification","key":"design_specification_review_in","kind":"design_specification","name":"Reviewed design specification","quantity":"one","required":true},{"description":"CAD model presented for design approval.","item":"geometry","key":"geometry_review_in","kind":"cad_model","name":"Bracket CAD model","quantity":"one","required":true},{"description":"Manufacturing evidence presented for design approval.","item":"manufacturability_report","key":"report_in","kind":"manufacturing_report","name":"Manufacturing check report","quantity":"one","required":true}]
  outputs: [{"description":"Exact CAD model revision approved by design review.","item":"approved_geometry","key":"approved_geometry_out","kind":"approved_cad_model","name":"Approved CAD model","quantity":"one","required":true}]
  instructions: "Approve only when the reviewed design specification, CAD model, and manufacturing check report agree and every issue has a recorded resolution."
  settings: {"required_role":"design-reviewer"}
  tool: null
  reusable_step: {"key":"review_cell","version":"^1.0.0"}
end

task export_step
  name: "Export approved STEP file"
  purpose: "Export the approved bracket CAD model as a neutral STEP file."
  step_type: work
  group: null
  performed_by: configured_tool
  inputs: [{"description":"Approved CAD model used for the STEP export.","item":"approved_geometry","key":"approved_geometry_in","kind":"approved_cad_model","name":"Approved CAD model","quantity":"one","required":true}]
  outputs: [{"description":"Neutral bracket CAD file for downstream use.","item":"step","key":"step_out","kind":"step_file","name":"STEP AP242 file","quantity":"one","required":true}]
  instructions: "Export STEP AP242 in millimetres from the approved CAD model and record its source revision."
  settings: {"format":"STEP AP242","overwrite":false}
  tool: {"action":"tool.export-step-ap242","assignment":"export_step"}
  reusable_step: null
end

task release_package
  name: "Create design handoff package"
  purpose: "Place the STEP file and manufacturing report in one local handoff package."
  step_type: work
  group: null
  performed_by: configured_tool
  inputs: [{"description":"Approved STEP file to include in the handoff package.","item":"step","key":"step_in","kind":"step_file","name":"STEP AP242 file","quantity":"one","required":true},{"description":"Manufacturing report to include in the handoff package.","item":"manufacturability_report","key":"report_package_in","kind":"manufacturing_report","name":"Manufacturing check report","quantity":"one","required":true}]
  outputs: [{"description":"Local ZIP containing the approved STEP file and manufacturing report.","item":"release_package","key":"package_out","kind":"handoff_package","name":"Design handoff package","quantity":"one","required":true}]
  instructions: "Create a local ZIP containing the approved STEP file and manufacturing report. Do not publish or send it."
  settings: {"classification":"internal","publish":false}
  tool: {"action":"package.local-review-bundle","assignment":"release_package"}
  reusable_step: null
end

connection design_intent_to_specification
  type: item
  from: "design_intent.design_intent_out"
  to: "create_design_specification.design_intent_in"
  label: "design intent"
  when: null
end

connection reference_to_specification
  type: item
  from: "reference_images.reference_images_out"
  to: "create_design_specification.reference_images_in"
  label: "reference images"
  when: null
end

connection context_to_specification
  type: item
  from: "company_context.company_context_out"
  to: "create_design_specification.company_context_in"
  label: "company context"
  when: null
end

connection specification_to_geometry
  type: item
  from: "create_design_specification.design_specification_out"
  to: "generate_geometry.design_specification_in"
  label: "reviewed design specification"
  when: "decision.specification-accepted"
end

connection specification_to_check
  type: item
  from: "create_design_specification.design_specification_out"
  to: "check_manufacturability.design_specification_check_in"
  label: "design criteria"
  when: "decision.specification-accepted"
end

connection geometry_to_check
  type: item
  from: "generate_geometry.geometry_out"
  to: "check_manufacturability.geometry_check_in"
  label: "CAD model"
  when: null
end

connection specification_to_review
  type: item
  from: "create_design_specification.design_specification_out"
  to: "review_design.design_specification_review_in"
  label: "design criteria"
  when: "decision.specification-accepted"
end

connection geometry_to_review
  type: item
  from: "generate_geometry.geometry_out"
  to: "review_design.geometry_review_in"
  label: "CAD model"
  when: null
end

connection report_to_review
  type: item
  from: "check_manufacturability.report_out"
  to: "review_design.report_in"
  label: "manufacturing report"
  when: null
end

connection review_to_export
  type: item
  from: "review_design.approved_geometry_out"
  to: "export_step.approved_geometry_in"
  label: "approved CAD model"
  when: "decision.accepted"
end

connection step_to_package
  type: item
  from: "export_step.step_out"
  to: "release_package.step_in"
  label: "STEP file"
  when: null
end

connection report_to_package
  type: item
  from: "check_manufacturability.report_out"
  to: "release_package.report_package_in"
  label: "manufacturing report"
  when: null
end

connection specification_accepted
  type: approval
  from: create_design_specification
  to: generate_geometry
  label: "Specification reviewed"
  when: "An engineer accepted the design specification and resolved or explicitly recorded all open questions"
end

connection specification_revise
  type: revision
  from: create_design_specification
  to: design_intent
  label: "Revise design inputs"
  when: "The design specification contains a conflict, unsupported assumption, or missing decision"
end

connection review_accepted
  type: approval
  from: review_design
  to: export_step
  label: "Accepted"
  when: "All required inputs present and warnings dispositioned"
end

connection review_revise
  type: revision
  from: review_design
  to: generate_geometry
  label: "Revise CAD model"
  when: "A design requirement or manufacturing issue is unresolved"
end
